_comment: Copy to oauth.json (gitignored) and build with: flutter build macos --dart-define-from-file=oauth.json
_google: Google Cloud console > Credentials > OAuth client ID > type 'Desktop app'. Add http://127.0.0.1:53682 as an authorised redirect URI. No secret is needed: Google documents client_secret as not applicable to installed apps, and Kandoo uses PKCE.
_notion: Notion integrations > Public integration. Notion supports no PKCE and authenticates the token exchange with HTTP Basic client_id:client_secret, so the secret cannot ship inside the app. Point NOTION_TOKEN_PROXY at a small endpoint you host that holds the secret, accepts {code, redirect_uri} as JSON and returns Notion's token response verbatim.
_notion_dev_only: Local development shortcut. Never set this in a build you distribute: anything in the binary can be extracted.
